channel.title: James Gartshore
channel.description: Free, friendly tech tips and poster design for Bridlington and the East Riding

item.title: Check Your Mobile Data
item.description: Your phone plan gives you a set amount of mobile data each month. Here's how to check how much you've used, so you don't go over and get charged extra.

item.title: Bright Sky: free, private help with domestic abuse
item.description: Today is the UN’s International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. I wanted to share a free app that could quietly help someone.

item.title: Share Your Location with Family
item.description: Out walking or driving on your own? You can share your location with someone you trust, so they can check you're OK.

item.title: Tracker Alerts
item.description: Today marks the start of the 16 Days of Activism against gender-based violence, so I wanted to share a phone safety feature that could really help someone.

item.title: Delete Apps You Never Use
item.description: Got apps on your phone you never use? Deleting them frees up space, cuts down on alerts and makes your home screen easier to use.

item.title: Is your Google account safe? Run a free check
item.description: Here’s a free 5-minute check that makes your Google and Gmail account safer.

item.title: Over State Pension age? Check for Pension Credit
item.description: If you or someone you know has reached State Pension age, it’s worth checking for Pension Credit.

item.title: Unsubscribe from emails in one tap
item.description: Is your inbox full of marketing emails? Gmail can stop them in a few taps.

item.title: Download a map before you go
item.description: Going somewhere with poor signal? Google Maps can work with no signal at all, if you save the area first.

item.title: Update All Your Apps
item.description: App updates fix problems and close the gaps that scammers use. You can update all your apps with one tap.

item.title: Lost your Android phone? Find it from any computer
item.description: Lost your Android phone? You can find it from any computer or tablet, even a friend’s.

item.title: Free Up Phone Space
item.description: Has your phone said its storage is full? Here's how to clear out what you don't need, without losing what you love.

item.title: Old cables and gadgets? Don’t bin them
item.description: It’s the European Week for Waste Reduction. Most of us have a drawer of old cables, chargers and phones, and they shouldn’t go in the bin.

item.title: Quiet Nights Do Not Disturb
item.description: Does your phone beep at night? Do Not Disturb keeps it quiet while you sleep, but you can still let family get through.

item.title: Marketplace Scams
item.description: With Black Friday and Christmas shopping coming up, I wanted to share some tips for buying and selling safely on Facebook Marketplace and similar sites.

item.title: Get more from your TV
item.description: It’s World Television Day, so here are a few ways to get more from your TV.

item.title: Aged 40 to 74? Get your free NHS Health Check
item.description: For International Men’s Day this week, a reminder about a free check that’s for everyone aged 40 to 74 in England.

item.title: Fake Ads and Shops
item.description: With Black Friday and Christmas shopping coming up, I wanted to share a warning about fake adverts and online shops.

item.title: Stop Annoying App Alerts
item.description: Is a shop or game app beeping at you all day? Here is how to turn off its notifications on Android and iPhone. Free local help, Bridlington & Driffield.

item.title: Looking after someone? Free help for carers
item.description: It’s Carers Rights Day. If you help a family member or friend who couldn’t manage without you, you’re a carer, even if you’ve never called yourself one.

item.title: Live Captions
item.description: Hard of hearing? Here is how to turn on Live Caption on your Android phone so you can read what is being said in videos.

item.title: Find a public toilet near you, on your phone
item.description: Find a public toilet near you, on your phone, with a free website. Handy for days out. Free local help, Bridlington & Driffield.

item.title: Get extra help in a power or water cut, for free
item.description: Did you know there’s a free list that tells your energy and water companies you may need extra help? It’s called the Priority Services Register.

item.title: Phone Reads Text Aloud
item.description: Did you know your phone can read things out loud to you? Great for long messages, or when your eyes are tired.

item.title: Worried someone you know is being scammed?
item.description: It’s Safeguarding Adults Week. Scammers often target people who live alone, and they can be very convincing. Here’s how to help someone you’re worried...

item.title: Phone Magnifying Glass
item.description: Left your glasses in the other room? Your phone's camera makes a great magnifying glass for tiny print on medicine boxes, menus and bills.

item.title: Power cut? Call 105
item.description: Power cut? Call 105, free, 24 hours a day, in England, Scotland and Wales. Here is what to do and what to keep ready before winter.

item.title: Stop. Think. Check. Then act.
item.description: It’s International Fraud Awareness Week. Scammers rely on rushing you, so a few seconds of thinking is your best protection.

item.title: Anti-Bullying Week
item.description: It's Anti-Bullying Week, and this year's theme is "Break the Silence". If a child or grandchild is being bullied online, here's how you can help.

item.title: Stop Autocorrect
item.description: Does your phone keep changing the words you type? Here is how to turn off autocorrect in Settings, step by step, in plain English.
